title: Sunday Chemex, half-batch
notes: Coarse grind, 60g bloom for 45 seconds, then three even pours. Washed Ethiopian keeps it bright without going thin.

title: Two weeks with a hand grinder
notes: Gave up the electric burr for a fortnight. The ritual slowed me down and the cups got noticeably sweeter — mostly because I stopped rushing the bloom.

title: Cold brew for humid mornings
notes: 1:10 concentrate, steeped at room temperature then chilled. Dilute 1:2 with water, or 1:1 with milk over ice.

title: Moka pot, no bitterness
notes: Start with pre-heated water so the grounds never scorch. Pull it off the heat the moment the stream turns pale.
